records.newEmployeeAria:
- main:
  - link "Team":
    - /url: /app/employees
  - heading "Add employee" [level=1]
  - paragraph: Their contact, access and scheduling details. Email is optional.
  - group:
    - region "Person":
      - heading "Person" [level=2]
      - text: First name
      - textbox "First name"
      - text: Last name
      - textbox "Last name"
      - text: Employee ID
      - textbox "Employee ID"
      - text: Unique. They use it to sign in. Phone
      - textbox "Phone":
        - /placeholder: 787-555-1234
      - text: They confirm it when they activate their account. Email
      - textbox "Email"
    - region "Access":
      - heading "Access" [level=2]
      - text: Access role
      - combobox "Access role":
        - option "Owner"
        - option "Manager"
        - option "Lead"
        - option "Employee" [selected]
      - text: What they can do in the app. Separate from job qualifications. Primary location
      - combobox "Primary location":
        - option "Choose a location" [disabled] [selected]
        - option "Main Office"
        - option "West Office"
      - text: They can always be scheduled here.
    - region "Scheduling":
      - heading "Scheduling" [level=2]
      - group "Positions":
        - text: Positions
        - paragraph: What they’re qualified to do. This is separate from their access role.
        - checkbox "Customer Support"
        - text: Customer Support
        - checkbox "Operations"
        - text: Operations
      - group "Locations they can work at":
        - text: Locations they can work at
        - paragraph: Their primary location is always included.
        - checkbox "Main Office"
        - text: Main Office
        - checkbox "West Office"
        - text: West Office
    - button "Add employee"
    - link "Cancel":
      - /url: /app/employees
  - region "What happens next":
    - heading "What happens next" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: Give them their Employee ID.
      - listitem: They open Activate account and enter their ID and phone number.
      - listitem: They create a password and sign in.
    - paragraph: The phone number must match when they activate, so check it carefully.

records.aria:
- main:
  - link "Shift requests":
    - /url: /app/exchange?tab=my
  - heading "Unable to work" [level=1]
  - paragraph: Tell your manager you can’t work this shift.
  - region "Your shift":
    - heading "Your shift" [level=2]
    - region "Can’t work":
      - paragraph: Can’t work
      - paragraph:
        - time: Tuesday, Oct 27, 2026
      - paragraph: 8:00 AM – 4:00 PM
      - paragraph: Main Office · Customer Support
      - paragraph: Times in Puerto Rico time
    - paragraph: It’s still your shift
    - paragraph: You’re responsible for it until a manager approves your report.
    - list:
      - listitem: A manager reviews your report. You can follow it in Shift requests.
      - listitem: If they approve it, the shift opens for someone else to pick up.
    - link "See my requests":
      - /url: /app/exchange?tab=requests
  - region "Why can’t you work it?":
    - heading "Why can’t you work it?" [level=2]
    - group:
      - text: Reason
      - combobox "Reason":
        - option "Choose a reason" [disabled] [selected]
        - option "Illness / sick"
        - option "Family emergency"
        - option "Transportation issue"
        - option "School conflict"
        - option "Personal emergency"
        - option "Other"
      - text: Choose the closest match. More details
      - textbox "More details":
        - /placeholder: What should your manager know?
      - text: Share only what your manager needs to review it. 0/300
      - paragraph: A manager reviews it. If they approve it, the shift opens for someone else to pick up.
      - button "Send report"
      - link "Cancel":
        - /url: /app/exchange?tab=my
